items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: But Alvin was always around when I needed help. Seemed like he would come in and out. And he helped me also.

ctx.x: Well, I understand Alvin is still living.
Alcorn. I never did play with Alvin. But Alvin was always around when I needed help. Seemed like he would come in and out. And he helped me also.
